reading.zh: 按启动链路排：TestScene（构建清单第 0 项，挂 Entry 起手）→ LoadingScene（读条）→ WorldScene（游戏世界）；EnterScene 未被 EditorBuildSettings 登记，排在最后。
reading.en: Ordered by the boot chain: TestScene (build entry 0, hosts Entry) → LoadingScene (progress) → WorldScene (the game world); EnterScene is not registered in EditorBuildSettings and sits last.
